noticias.titulo: The AI Stock Market Wobble Is a Reminder: This Time Isn’t Different - WSJ
noticias.resumo: AI stocks have had a terrible few days as hot inflation raises the cost of finance and threatens the debt-fueled investment in data centers.  Investors showed they are alive to one of the big risks in AI, that hopes for trillions of dollars of capital spending might be derailed.  An even bigger risk: construction continues at full speed.
